reviewMethod: Directed non-blinded builder review of every graded failure; annotations do not alter machine grades.

c2ccd555-0270-4b68-bf70-e86250829394.reason: The single early slot ID matches the stated 2 PM date/time/timezone, and “Do you want to confirm this slot?” explicitly requests acceptance. The bounded request matcher rejects that valid phrase. The run later books and confirms correctly.

ddcf2b90-6343-4ea7-8834-28674df139c6.reason: event-8 records “Appointment booked” before the initial create_appointment at event-9, which fails stale-slot validation. A later alternative booking succeeds at event-13, but event-16 uses slot-afternoon-late as appointmentId and is rejected as FALSE_BOOKING_CONFIRMATION. Both the premature note and wrong confirmation reference are genuine errors.

d7286c0e-33bc-4d56-b7e7-c0bcd37853c3.reason: No booking/recovery occurs after the stale-slot rejection, consistent with A’s deliberately inferior handoff workflow. The factual note says the lead consented to book, not that booking succeeded; “book” is outside the note vocabulary and is conservatively rejected. The selected-slot decline text truthfully says “no longer available,” which the decline matcher misses. Its decline_booking call is also rejected because the calendar still contains an available alternative.

c5a3008f-f30b-4400-b532-7085aab43a46.reason: A follows its deliberate handoff-after-rejection instruction and never creates a replacement appointment. e4b0bb7a-3ace-42c3-a46b-8b8a222a22fa.reason: After the lead explicitly opts out and set_contact_opt_out succeeds, B attempts to send an acknowledgement (“You have been removed from our contact list…”), using decline_booking intent.
